# OpenOlat i18n translation reference

*Generated by `scripts/14_gen_translation_reference.py` on 2026-09-09 from the OpenOlat concept map, 862 terms. Do not edit this file by hand.*

The machine-readable version is `i18n-translation-reference.yaml`, next to this file. It carries every field this table omits: the anchor keys, the keep-apart warnings, the forbidden verbs and the wordings this entry supersedes.

To change a translation, edit the concept map (`fxIntelligence/knowledge/openolat/concept-map/model/`), not this file or the YAML. Both are regenerated from the map.

## How to use this document

Look up the English term below to find the decided translation in the target language. These are the canonical translations used throughout OpenOlat.

A blank cell means the code has no translation for that language yet, or the term is new. Leave it blank rather than guessing; add the translation to the code and regenerate.

Most values come from the `LocalStrings_<lang>.properties` files. Where a native speaker decided a term on a translation worksheet that the code does not carry yet, the decided term is shown instead; the YAML marks it with `<lang>_source: proposed` (`proposed_unsure` where the speaker asked for a review).

The end-user glossary is a separate document: `OpenOLAT-docs/sites/reference_glossary/`. It explains what a term means. This file only maps a term between languages.

To add a new language to this reference: generate a worksheet with `scripts/15_gen_language_worksheet.py --lang <code>`, have a native speaker fill it, then import it back with `scripts/16_import_language_worksheet.py`.

## Rules

Rules that apply across every term in this reference. The full explanation is `concept-map/model/_rules.md`; this section renders the machine-readable summary from `_rules.yaml`.

### Gender forms

German uses a brace notation for gendered word endings, e.g. `Betreuer{in}`. The application expands the brace into one of several separators (star, colon, dot) depending on the site's configuration. The brace is a suffix append only: it works when the female form is the male form plus an ending, and not otherwise.

| Ending | Use | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `{innen}` | Plural | |
| `{in}` | Singular | |
| `{r}` | substantiviertes Adjektiv, z.B. Ausbildungsverantwortliche{r} | |
| `{n}` | Artikel-/Adjektivdeklination, z.B. ihre{n} Betreuer{in} | |
| `{e}` | Artikel, z.B. ein{e} Moderator{in} | |
| `{inn}` | vor weiterlaufendem en, z.B. Autor{inn}enrechte | |
| `{inne}` | Dativ Plural, z.B. Kursteilnehmer{inne}n | |
| `{s}` | Genitivartikel, eine{s} Moderator{in} | |

The gender mechanism applies to every language with a configured strategy, not only German. Measured use: de 2240, fr 647, it 1, en 2, pt_BR 0, es 0.

### Verbs

**Tier A.** Das Verb eines Konzepts ist das Verb seines Substantivs. Derive the verb from the noun; do not list it.

**Tier C.** A closed list of UI action verbs, independent of any concept:

| Action | Deutsch | Also seen (retire) |
|---|---|---|
| Edit | bearbeiten | editieren, anpassen, ändern |
| Select | auswählen | wählen |
| Add | hinzufügen | einfügen, ergänzen |
| Enable | aktivieren | einschalten |
| Complete | abschliessen | beenden, fertigstellen |
| Send | senden | versenden, absenden |
| Download | herunterladen | downloaden |
| Collect | einziehen | einsammeln, abholen |
| Instantiate | instanziieren | instanzieren |

Three verbs must stay apart, because German currently blurs them:

| Deutsch | English | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| löschen | Delete | zerstört das Objekt |
| entfernen | Remove | löst es aus diesem Kontext |
| ausblenden | Hide | ändert nur die Sichtbarkeit |

### Retired word stems

Some concepts ran on several word stems in the code. One stem survives; the others are retired and must not be used in new strings.

| Concept | Keep (noun / verb / state) | Retire |
|---|---|---|
| publication | Veröffentlichung / veröffentlichen / Veröffentlicht | publizieren, Publikation |
| enrolment | Einschreibung / einschreiben / Eingeschrieben | Belegt, Eintragungen |

| Freigabe | Release | Deutsch aufteilen - Zugang = Access, Media-Freigabe = Share |
| Erledigt | Done |  |
| Beendet | Finished |  |

| Ausgebucht | Fully booked | order.status.written.off muss auf Abgeschrieben wechseln |
